name: promptback-monorepo
description: Semantic search over every prompt you've sent to your AI coding agents. Local-first.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/cli && npm run build -w packages/vscode
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p packages/vscode && tsc -p packages/vscode/webview
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
